newsitem.title: GERMANY: Waigel-Wrong to talk of EMU delay at this time.
newsitem.headline: Waigel-Wrong to talk of EMU delay at this time.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Thursday that would be wrong to talk of delay to Europe's single currency project at this time.

"Currently we are in the middle of the year that will decide currency union so talk of a delay would be wrong," Waigel told reporters in response to a question on whether there should be a postponement.
Waigel added, "Germany will do everything to meet the criteria" for European Economic and Monetary union (EMU).
Speaking at a meeting of German city governments, Waigel also said that privatisation would continue in Germany and may be intensified.
The finance minister also reiterated that the Bonn government was not considering rhe sale of Bundesbank gold reserves.
